## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Market signals mixed — SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -2.55% | 1M: +1.04%) and VXX (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -11.25%) BELOW TREND show risk pullback but sector breadth and credit are neither clearly bullish nor bearish, confirming Neutral.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit roughly neutral: HYG (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION → HYG/LQD direction flat. Fear easing but not absent: VXX (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -11.25%) BELOW TREND → downward, while SPY/TLT mixed with TLT (1W: -0.99% | 1M: -0.81%) BELOW TREND indicating modest yield pressure.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-cautious: TLT (1W: -0.99% | 1M: -0.81%) BELOW TREND → yields drifting higher, while dollar and broader liquidity indicators are flat per regime inputs, leaving financial conditions balanced.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Healthcare leading: XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND; Energy also strong: XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging in a short-term pullback: XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) — style: Value/cyclicals showing relative strength versus Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US mixed but less weak: SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -2.55% | 1M: +1.04%) while QQQ in CORRECTION (1W: -3.59% | 1M: +3.04%). EM and China remain soft: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.18% | 1M: -1.26%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.87% | 1M: -6.75%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Weakening: IBIT (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -20.95%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND show speculative retrenchment; small caps IWM in CORRECTION (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +0.66%) — selective risk-taking remains.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Metals under pressure: GLD (1W: -3.40% | 1M: -7.97%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -9.00% | 1M: -13.99%) BELOW TREND; industrial metals mixed with CPER in CORRECTION (1W: -3.53% | 1M: +3.21%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Mixed but constructive: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) while broad oil proxies like BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -3.32%); natural gas UNG in CORRECTION (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +6.46%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLV and XLE ABOVE TREND (both 1W & 1M positive). MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple tech/industry ETFs (XLK, SOXX, CIBR, IGV) show 1W negative vs 1M positive → MAJOR divergence, so avoid large directional convictions.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to sectors showing strength (XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to the most speculative buckets (IBIT (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -20.95%) BELOW TREND, ARKK (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND); bonds remain a neutral hedge.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND if defensive flows continue; XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND on energy re-risking. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION and QQQ (1W: -3.59% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION if tech outflows persist.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: -3.53% | 1M: +3.21%) CORRECTION if industrial demand picks up; UNG (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +6.46%) CORRECTION for weather-driven volatility. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -3.40% | 1M: -7.97%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -9.00% | 1M: -13.99%) BELOW TREND if rates remain firm.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency needle), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health gauge), XLK/XLV relative ~2.0 (growth vs defensive pivot), SPY 50-day (near-term momentum reference).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive.  
Healthcare (XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND) and Energy (XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength.  
Key risk: MAJOR divergence in tech/industry ETFs (XLK (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION et al.) — monitor for trend resolution.
